title: Robin in the Hood
style: Phonk heist track with hyper-speed bounce, rattling drums, and dembow-tinted four-on-the-floor energy; verse rides tight, clipped bars and callouts, pre-chorus strips to a tense pulse and siren blur, chorus hits with gang vocals and a chantable hook. Double-tracked leads, shouted ad-libs, filtered radio talk, reversed risers into each drop, cash-register clicks and tire-screech transitions. Bright, gritty, and punchy with a dusty low-end., fake, rock, bounce
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed, I can, you got this
We believe, Math Driver
3 Mirrors, Phonk track bounce
Here’s my boys, thrash this toy
Take the right lane, hyper speed plane
Police chatter, sirens sound
Unit 336, coming round
A robin a robin out of the mansion
Fake a break, chase and cage
Extra stripe for no rage
You heard the sarg, chase and cage
Thrash this toy, catch that boy

[Pre-Chorus]
Phonky sneaky phonk
Thrift drift kick
Give them rage in our cage
Math Driver, the architect
The plan, the dream
Done safe, done sound
Our robin, our robin

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood!
but its for good!
Bust em like we should, ha bro
if we could!

[Verse 2]
Math driver, no way back
We go to stay, escape this place
Math driver thrash this toy
G4 hyperpeed, you got this boy
Delta track, D J Zyn Rose
We got this, pedals everywhere
Sand box city, eyes full of sand
Where are my toys? a bored stare
Like we care, ground hog day
Sand box say, but I forget
What 8 is for
V D S Mansion!
We go now, Hyperspeed!

[Pre-Chorus]
Unit 336 on the line
False front, clean getaway
Math driver, keep it moving
One more turn, then out the gate
Thrash this toy
Catch that boy
No more cage
No more cage

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood!
but its for good!
Bust em like we should, ha bro
if we could!

[Bridge]
V D S mansion, party for me
V D S mansion, party for me
Sand box city, sand box city
No more cage, no more cage
Math Driver, the architect
Delta, alpha, lock and roll
Here’s my boys, thrash this toy
Then we vanish whole

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood!
but its for good!
Bust em like we should, ha bro
if we could!
